summary: Iterates a singly linked list seeded from the head pointer at this+0x4 into a cursor at this+0xC, accumulating ShortComputation_58d0 of each node's first DWORD (the node's value) until the cursor is null or the node value is zero. Advances via the node's next pointer at node+4. Returns the accumulated sum.

operations.description: Initialize the sum accumulator v2 to 0.
Seed the iteration cursor this[3] (offset 0xC) from the list head this[1] (offset 0x4).
Infinite loop over the list, breaking when the current node pointer is null.
Read the current node's first DWORD; break the loop when it is zero.
Add ShortComputation_58d0(node value) to the accumulator v2.
Advance the cursor this[3] to the node's next pointer stored at node+4.
